title: fleet: RunPool with a nil launcher reports every lane as a success; plus a dead nil-check, an incomplete global zone, and a CPU-spinning test
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 10 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) RunPool with a nil launch returns len(backlog) zero-value results, with ExitCode 0 and Err nil, so every lane looks like a success. Supervisor.Run returns errNoLaunch in the same case. (2) Supervisor.launchOne still nil-checks Launch, but Run already rejects that through Validate, so the branch is dead. (3) globalZoneFiles holds only go.mod, go.sum and .evolve/policy.json; the merge-concurrency research also names hooks and generated files as global-zone. (4) TestSupervisor_BoundedConcurrency waits in an empty spin loop with no timeout. (5) WARN prefixes disagree: quota.go writes '[loop] WARN: fleet:' and freshness.go writes '[fleet] WARN:'. 13-loopwave.md already lists this as F2.
fix: Make RunPool reject a nil launcher the way Supervisor.Run does, with a test. Remove the dead branch. Decide the global zone from the research and pin it with a test. Replace the spin loop with a channel wait bounded by a timeout. Route fleet warnings through the Signal Center with one module prefix.
acceptance: RunPool with a nil launcher returns an error, not success results (test)
globalZoneFiles matches the documented global zone (test)
TestSupervisor_BoundedConcurrency has a timeout and does not spin
